protocol.seed_selection: Nearest already published visual anchor to six preselected pilot times; no annotation coordinates used.
protocol.camera_compensation: Moving crop centered on seed point transformed by floor homographies; approximate for non-floor objects. Reject explicit edit range.
protocol.purpose: Compare learned spatiotemporal point propagation against the sparse detector baseline; output proposals, not automatically accepted tracking.
protocol.selection: On development seed intervals only, maximize within_25px - 3*outside_25px, then within_12px, then fewer outside_25px. Compare frozen filtered variants; report validation separately. All references are reused development observations.
protocol.evaluation: Same six seeds and camera-compensated windows as prior TAPNext++ pilot. Exclude every seed and its +-3 frames. Compare raw mask centers and shape/appearance-filtered centers. No labels used as inference prompts.
protocol.fusion: Retain original visual anchors. Compare appearance-filtered TAPNext++ and SAM. If agreeing within 25 native pixels choose the higher appearance score; otherwise prefer the higher score only if its margin is at least 0.2, and retain TAP on smaller conflicts. Keep the final output one position.
protocol.audit: Inspect 24 added or changed candidate positions selected evenly by time after freezing outputs. Review before/after native crops; include visible errors and unclear cases. Do not treat unknown ball locations as correct.
protocol.scope: NBHL ball hockey, same previously examined five-minute recording; no independent or new-game accuracy claim. No model weight fine-tuning in this experiment.

pilot.limits: Reused approximate assistant annotations on one previously examined five-minute NBHL recording. Validation is a seed-window split, not an independent game or human benchmark.

decision.scope: Default for this existing five-minute NBHL development replay only.
decision.summary: SAM3 point prompts + TAPNext++ increase correctly localized reviewed proposals from 46 to 67 (within 25 pixels), and final video-tracked frames from 91 to 122. Visual audit: 20 of 24 changes close to a visible ball, 4 unverified, no clear wrong location. Same-game development evidence; two previously known drift errors remain.
rejected: Box prompting is weaker in the pilot and larger comparison.
The exploratory multi-seed consensus override produced identical output and is not used.
limitations: The point variant was chosen after inspecting pilot validation results; its larger run is exploratory.
Overall estimated coverage remains 79.7%. This does not establish full-game accuracy or reliable occluded-ball positions.
SAM tracking is sensitive to seed frame and prompt choice. The two known stick-blade errors at frames 4021 and 4026 remain.

exploratory_amendment.stage: After six-seed pilot; before either 31-seed run
exploratory_amendment.reason: Frozen development selection chose box-768 (2 correct vs point-768 1). In validation windows it gave only 4 correct vs TAP 20. Point-768 gave 26 correct in validation, so expand it as an explicitly post-hoc exploratory candidate. Do not relabel it as independently selected or validated.
exploratory_amendment.all_seeds: Use the same existing 31 visual seeds, half-window, mask and appearance thresholds, fusion rules and 24-position audit selection. No retuning after the 31-seed results.
exploratory_amendment.deployment: Report both full runs. Inspect 24 evenly spaced changed or added point-SAM candidate outputs before making a deployment decision; unchanged visual anchors and one output position remain required.

fusion_amendment.stage: During 31-seed inference, before reading or evaluating its numeric outputs
fusion_amendment.baseline_policy: Preserve and report the protocol conservative 0.2 appearance-margin fusion.
fusion_amendment.motivation: The previously reviewed frame 4021 has an incorrect TAP proposal scoring 0.869. A SAM score capped at 1 cannot beat it by 0.2, so the conservative rule cannot correct it even if multiple SAM seeds independently converge on the visible ball. This is targeted development from an existing failure, not an independent test.
fusion_amendment.rule: After the existing shape, appearance and context gates, allow SAM to override a conflicting TAP point when at least two distinct SAM seeds agree within 12 native pixels, both have appearance >=0.9, and the best SAM score is no more than 0.05 below TAP. Otherwise use the frozen conservative rule. Emit only the highest-scoring SAM center, never a second point.
fusion_amendment.review: Report conservative and consensus variants separately. Audit up to 24 evenly spaced changed or added consensus replay points using original and neighboring video frames. Do not claim new-game accuracy.

output_audit.sampling: 24 positions evenly spaced by time among added or changed SAM centers, frozen before image review.
output_audit.review: Assistant review of native crops plus preceding/following and full video frames. Approximate visible centers are rounded to five native pixels; no subpixel accuracy claim. This is conditional output inspection, not independent human ground truth.

limits: All references and audit decisions are approximate assistant observations on a previously examined NBHL recording.

The six-seed comparison has identical reviewed positions, with seed frames and their +-3 neighbors excluded. Configuration selection uses development windows only; validation windows are still from the same development game.
The 31-seed comparison uses a different set of windows and references. Conditional error among emitted points is not recall or full-video precision.
Context estimates are unchanged. More output is not evidence of correct invisible-ball localization. No new fine-tuning or additional language-model calls were performed.
The replay emits one selected location. Held, airborne and height-uncertain locations have no floor projection.
